title: Le Portugal n'est pas chassé par la guerre de Sept Ans
purpose: Preserve the chronology correction because the intuitive compressed narrative is plausible enough to recur.
reason_off_trunk: The Portuguese chronology corrects a false explanation but is not itself a causal step in the Anglo-French-to-British sequence.
payoff: The reader returns to the European-war sequence distinguishing long Portuguese contraction from the later Anglo-French strategic asymmetry.
